run_my_app: run the Hydra app that instantiates a recursive Tree from config and pretty prints it
instantiate_tree_from_config: use hydra utils instantiate to create a Tree object from a TreeConf config node
create_tree_conf: create a TreeConf dataclass with _target_ pointing to Tree and recursive left and right fields
pretty_print_tree: recursively pretty print a Tree structure showing each node value with indented left and right children
register_config_schema: register a Config dataclass with ConfigStore so Hydra can resolve it by name
